## Cleaning patients data set

### Extracting a list of patient ID from the mutations data set

```{r}
tumor_id <- mutations |> 
              group_by(Tumor_Sample_Barcode) |> 
              count() |> 
              rename(Number_mutations = n)
```

```{r}
tumor_id <- tumor_id |> 
            separate_longer_position(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, width = 9) |> 
            filter(str_detect(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, "P")) |> 
            rename(PATIENT_ID = Tumor_Sample_Barcode)
```
Modifying the tumor bar code so that it matches the patient IDs format that are in the other two data sets we are working with.

Extracting from patients the IDs that do not appear in mutations.

```{r}
patients_clean <- patients |> 
                      inner_join(tumor_id, join_by("PATIENT_ID"))
```
Now the patient_clean contains the information relevant to the patients that are also mentioned in the mutation file and an additional column stating the number of mutations that patient has.

```{r}
samples_clean <- samples |>
                    semi_join(tumor_id, by = "PATIENT_ID")
```
Same for samples data set.
